label: Mid/late original-phase input of v/d/c/l/i/x/2/3
explanation: Fires mostly (90% of mass) during the original-input phase, from position 3 onward, peaking at positions 4-6, when the current input is one of a specific token set: v, d, c, l, i (strongest, v > d > c), plus x, 2 and 3. It almost never fires at t=0 or at the delimiter, and is weak at positions 1-2. Rate rises with L and is higher on the first occurrence of a token. Top activations occur when f/n/j appeared earlier in the sequence (first_tok n/f/j has about 2x lift), but adding that condition barely changes F1. A smaller copy-phase component (about 10% of mass) fires mostly when outputting f (and somewhat p/j/n) early in the copy. Precision is only about 0.44: these tokens at late positions often do not fire, so the unit looks like a graded token-identity times position signal rather than a clean binary rule. Dev F1 0.52, mass recall 0.77.
